title: Works great! (+ feature request)
body:
best things about the app:
- cheap one-time premium purchase!
- being able to retroactively add data if you forgot or otherwise was unable to. like omg thank you i forget to log stuff a lot
- neat stats and report views. the "pixels" view is cool! (they take a few secs to load though)
- wide selection of colors & decent selection of icons for each habit
- being able to archive habits that are no longer needed, and reactivate them as needed. so clean!
- apple health sync!!!!!

what would immensely improve the experience imo: 
- a way to group the habits by some form of category in the home view. like a colored header that represents the life area (eg. work, health) or time of day!
i have many habits, so it would really make the view a lot neater and organized; using filters each time gets annoying, so having something easy to show and hide on the spot would make using the app much smoother. plus it could actually frame the various habits of one section as a routine, if one uses the sections that way.
- multiline description!!! i need to see a checklist / reminder list of things i need to complete certain habits, and not being able to have proper line breaks clutters up the view a lot.
- having something other than a tiny "S" for skipped habits in the weekly report. it's hard to see depending on the habit's color, and doesn't really read well intuitively.

i appreciate the new "bad habits" update btw 👀 and i really like the new look of the days on the too row of the home view.

(as an aside: i do notice a lot of typos and language imperfections, which could make the app feel the tiniest bit "clumsy". but i know that english is a horrible language, so i get it.)

title: I recommend this habit tracker all the time
body: In the past I haven’t had any success with habit trackers. I have ADHD and most of them held my attention for a day or two, maybe a week, then I would miss some days, I would feel super guilty, and I didn’t want to open the app again. I’ve used this habit tracker for a year and counting, and I really don’t know why it is so different. It could be the ability to still ‘log’ the days you don’t do something. Instead of filling in the rectangle, it puts a triangle in that space, and that feels like neutral data instead of a personal failing. With this app I found out that I exercised 60% of the time, wrote 80% of the time, never went more than three days without flossing, and I have a ‘high energy’ day WAY more often than I think. In fact, I think this app allows me to live up to my values, because I can provide myself with regular proof—I am the person I want to be.

title: Awesome Habits. Awesome App.
body:
Every time I start with a new productivity system I over complicate it. Not with this. Empty rings bad. Filled rings good. Habits are incredibly simple to set up and customize. Back filling is easy and day/week/month views are great. The widgets put habits front and center and performing a habit has become a welcome alternative to getting swept up in social media. 

With my setup, a “meh” day means about 70%— C work, but a better baseline (and better streaks!) than I’ve had in the past. 100% days really count and include a mix of baseline habits, tracked dietary needs, and other positive activities. 

I only have two (minor) complaints:
- You can seemingly only change the primary ring color by changing the app to mono. Can we please set the primary ring color separately?
- Similarly, you can’t set colors on lists, so you have to manage lists and colors separately. List colors, still separate from individual habit colors but with the option to apply to all habits, would be hugely appreciated. 

Wishlist:
- Expanding on the above, a view with a circle for each list’s progress with respective colors + an icon for each
- Mark a habit as “Bonus” so it contributes to the total percentage in a way that can exceed 100%

My recommendation— Get it. There are similar apps out there, but none that balance simplicity and functionality in such a satisfyingly iOS-like way.

title: Nice app with a two flaws that kill it for me
body:
This app is so close to being amazing. I would use it as my main habit app, if it was not for two problems that are severe for how I want to use it, making the app unusable for me personally. 

1) When tracking time for a habit, if you accidentally add the wrong amount of time, there seems to be no way to undo it except to reset the timer for the full day. Thus, if you are not aware how much time you had already accumulated and then you make a mistake, you completely lose track of your tracked time for the days. This has happened to me so many times I've lost count.

2) When adding time to a time-tracking habit, if you don't perfectly hit the center of checkmark representing that some amount of time should be added, you instead return, and refrain from adding time. It is very easy to accidentally do this and think you have added the time when you have not. 

If the developers fixed these two issues I'd be very happy to return to the app.

title: ポップでかわいい
body:
2025年4月追記
大幅に変わったので評価下げます。
もう使ってません。
────────
2023年5月時点の感想
使いやすくて、かわいいデザインがGOOD!
ただ、
カスタマイズ性が低い。
アカウントの登録はあれど、削除ができない。
モチベはそこまで上がらない。

良いところ
・無料で使える！！
・広告の入れ方が良心的
・オフラインでも使えて秒で開ける
・日々のコツコツが可視化され
  記録を振り返りやすい
・目標をいくつも設定できる
・付け忘れても日付を遡って記録できる*
・途中でサボっても続行可能
・シンプルでポップなデザイン
・日本語対応

リスト表示とカレンダー表示が可能で、記録が見やすい。
通知を何度も設定してリマインドできるし
通知文を好きに編集できるのも良い。

惜しいところ
▼１発でポンと記録できるようにして欲しい
 長押し→確定 が最短手順だけど
 １発で確定される記録方法があれば とてもうれしいです。
▼カスタマイズ性が低い
カラーと通知設定は自由度が高いものの
それ以外はほぼ変えられない。 
1.)記録の種類
「毎日｣「１カウント」のみ。
 これ以外の選択肢がないため
↓こういう内容には不向き。
 週に何回か決まった曜日だけやる
 朝昼晩など１日に何度かやる
（薬の飲み忘れチェックなど）
2.)カレンダー表示に固定したい
 ドットが並んでる画はかわいくてミニマルな美しさがありますが、
 私は日付と結びつけて振り返りたい派なので
 常にカレンダーにしておきたいです。
3.)カレンダーを月曜始まりにしたい
▼登録情報の削除ができない
 複数の端末で同期するには
メールアドレスを登録し、アカウント作成を求められる。
 だが、登録したら最後
メールアドレスを削除する方法や、それに関する案内が一切ない。
 アカウントからログアウトするボタンがあるのみ。
 これは他の方のレビューでも指摘があるが改善されていない。 
 不親切過ぎる。
▼サボると翌日から通知が来なくなる
 バグなのか仕様なのか分からないが、これでは通知を設定してる意味がない。
 この現象は、登録した目標を全てサボった場合に発生。
 どれか１つでも記録すれば
通知が途絶えることはありません。
 最初、目標を１つだけにしていたので
その１つをサボると翌日はいつも通知が来なかった。
 iPad9th iOS16.3.1
 このアプリ1.6.5
▼*目標を作った日より前には遡って記録できない
 日付を遡って記録できるのが強みの１つなのだが、
このアプリを入れる前から既に継続している事の
過去の記録は付けられないのが残念。
▼その日達成済みの項目にも通知が来てしまう
 通知時刻より先に達成して記録を付けても、
 時間になると通知が来てしまうのが紛らわしくて煩わしい。
▼バッジが付かない
 個人的には、通知センターだけでなく
バッジも付いた方が「やらなきゃ」という気になれるので
 あればうれしいです。 
▼１年以上アプデがない
バージョン履歴を見ると
数年前はそれなりの頻度で手を入れていた形跡がある。
今も不具合を訴えるレビューをちらほら見かけるのに
最近は全くアプデがない。
これでひとつの完成ということにして
作者がもう見切っちゃったのかなぁという印象。
▼モチベをガツンと上げる･維持するには弱い 
 だらしなくて意志薄弱な私は
このアプリだけではモチベにならなかった。
 ドットは可愛いけど
穴が空いても別に気にならないし、
隙間なくドットを埋めた時タイルみたいになるのが
継続の結果というより
最初からのデザインに見えてしまって
私にとっては達成感があまり感じられなかったのです。

例えば、こんな機能があれば違うかも。
設定した目標を全て達成した日は褒めてくれる とか、
10日くらい連続記録できたら
めちゃくちゃ褒めちぎってくれる とか、
ドットを埋めた時に 達成感を感じる心地良い音が鳴る など。

それから、
画像付の記録をどんどん溜め込んでいくと
当然ながらその分だけ容量を喰います。
私はある程度データが大きくなったらこのアプリの記録は消しても良いつもりで
別の手段でも記録を残してる。
（ちなみに、このアプリはiCloudのバックアップファイルも そこそこデカくなる）

この辺は個人の好みによります。
基本的には良いアプリです。

title: Love it !!!
body: Love this app so much.  It has many different features that i find useful! I like doing the challenges or journeys to give you a structure motivation to complete something and helps shake things up when you’ve gotten into a rut. There is a whole community on there if you need help from others going threw the same thing. I even love that you can go back to check mark things in the pass in case you forgot to be keeping track but still want to track your progress. I think it’s great that they add a learning and informational aspect to there program making it better that just your average habit tracker which help you developer skills and a mind set to over come difficulties. I admit I haven’t always stayed on tray but they’ve added a new service that I’m interested in trying that involves a personalized routine and coach for what’s going on in your life right now. It’s fun that they keep track of your streaks I find it motivating but also that they have little freeze rewards so even when you miss a day it preserves your streak while also promoting that just because you missed a day or two doesn’t mean everything stops. You just get back on track because consistency is more important than being perfect. We are only human after all. It’s fantastic that you can make as many lists as you want the only thing is I wish that they was an area I can see everything on my lists in one place because sometimes it gets annoying/ overwhelming to look into each list and sometimes I forget things because I didn’t look at each individual  list but I still like to have them separate to have it organized. Maybe it’s a feature the fabulous team will look into developing in the future :D Also would love for you guys to bring back the lifetime subscription.

title: Added to my stress
body:
During a period of suffering with depression, I decided to try this app to get me out of a rut.  I used it for a day and quickly got fed up with it.  Unfortunately, I forgot to cancel the subscription and ended up paying for a year. I gave the app another go, this time for a couple of weeks seeing as I’d ended up paying for it. The constant nudges to invite and challenge other people was really irritating.  I accidentally ticked that I’d taken my medication one day and discovered that you cannot undo a task ticked off by mistake (this, in my opinion is worrying). 
I’ve stopped using the app now and I feel like a weight has been lifted from my shoulders, I’m no longer tying myself up in knots trying to keep up with random challenges or making pinky promises with my phone to go and drink a glass of water.

title: Basic but still missing basics
body:
I like the layout of the app. Clean. Refreshing. It's quick to log. Reminders is nice. But a few key basics it's missing: 1. No way to view each entry or edit each entry. This is inconvenient because you can't tell whether you logged for the day or not nor can you tell what you logged. Also, when I logged my first value I chose add to total but all it did was erase the starting value and put it at the value I had entered. Example: starting value was 200. I logged 4 thinking that would bring my progress to 204 but instead it brought it to 4. I then tried to edit the entry but couldn't find a way to do that. So I decided to log an entry and this time I put my total as 204 but then this time it added it to the 4 it had making it now 208. Ugh. Would appreciate an edit button. 

2. Reminders- a great feature EXCEPT when you already log for the day before the alarm goes off. Because then it keeps that reminder badge thinking that since no input has been made after the reminder was issued that you have not logged anything. I could change the reminder to occur super early but the whole point is to remind at a time when best convenient. And hey, if you remember to log before the reminder you shouldn't be punished with a reminder badge lingering. Also it would be great if I could set multiple reminders for the day. For example I'm trying to get into the habit of logging calories so it would be great if I could have it remind me three times a day. Because with one reminder I may forget the other meals. 

3. Okay the dashboard is nice but without more functionality (like zoom in, see entries, etc) it seems kind of pointless. It would be nice if it would tell you your projected date at current pace and what pace you should have to reach projected date. Perhaps that's too advance but it would be a nice, usable feature. 

Overall, knowing what I know now, would I have paid for it then? Probably not. Maybe $1 but that's it. To me it's missing necessary features for a goal/habit app. It's off to a good start.

This cannot be undone.” And I absolutely hate that. It feels so condescending and it comes up EVERY time I log a habit. I sought out a habit tracking app, chose this one after researching, and then actually set it up…why am I being accused of lying? Would I go through all this effort just to misrepresent my habits and thus undermine the entire purpose of this app? It may be enough for me to delete it altogether and chose a different habit app. I hope the developers see this and remove that patronizing “Be honest” message.
